title: Aitzoas HaMivooaroas — complete bilingual Reader audit

audit_scope.method: Every final Hebrew-English pair was independently reviewed for semantic completeness and exact boundary alignment. Repaired pairs received a separate recheck.

source_structure.unit_rule: The 556 emitted units preserve the ordered chapter entries from the supplied Hebrew DOCX. Chapter 8 entries 20 and 21 and the chapter 26 introduction/first entry were separated where the legacy import had merged them.

repair_summary: Replaced the incomplete 12-section import with the complete 26-chapter Hebrew corpus.
Filled all 135 initially empty English units.
Corrected large cyclic and shifted English assignments in chapters 1, 6, 24, and 25.
Corrected merged boundaries in chapters 8 and 26.
Restored omitted clauses, references, negations, repeated explanations, and source ambiguities found during independent review.
Re-audited every corrected range; the final audit reports no remaining alignment failure, omission, or truncation.
